title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join our client's busy customer contact team on a temporary basis.

You will support customers across telephone, email, live chat and social media, answering a wide variety of queries relating to products, orders and installations. You will take ownership of each enquiry, working to resolve questions and complaints effectively while delivering a positive customer experience.

Package for a Customer Service Advisor:

Salary: 13.46 - 14.56 per hour, depending on experience
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Saturday. Saturdays are worked on a rota, with a day off during the week
Contract: Temporary
Location: Bath, hybrid
- Varied, multichannel customer service role
- Opportunity to develop your complaint-handling and problem-solving experience
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Saturday shifts balanced with a weekday off

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Responding to customer enquiries through telephone, email, live chat and social media
- Providing accurate information about products, orders and installations
- Taking ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution
- Handling complaints professionally and working towards first-contact resolution
- Contacting customers to arrange installations, explain the process and answer questions
- Listening carefully to customers and identifying the most appropriate solution
- Communicating complex information in a clear and accessible way
- Contributing ideas to improve processes across the team and wider business
- Sharing useful information with colleagues and updating internal knowledge systems
- Maintaining a professional, empathetic and positive approach throughout every interaction

Key Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Previous B2 C customer service experience gained within a contact centre, retail or another customer-focused environment
- Experience handling complaints and taking ownership through to resolution
- Confident and professional verbal and written communication skills
- Strong listening and questioning skills
- Ability to simplify complex information and explain it clearly
- Empathetic approach and the ability to communicate with customers from a wide range of backgrounds
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
- Positive, can-do approach with a willingness to learn and develop

If you are an experienced customer service professional who enjoys solving problems and taking ownership of customer enquiries, please apply now!

title: Interim Part-Time Finance Officer
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your New Company

Hays are delighted to be partnering with a well-established organisation in the Bath area to recruit a Part-Time Finance Officer on a temporary basis, working 20 hours per week. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a friendly and supportive finance team in a varied role where your work will directly support members.
Your New Role
As a Finance Officer, you'll play a key role in the administration and delivery of a range of schemes. Combining finance administration with customer service, you'll manage funding applications and payments while providing clear and helpful support.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing applications, awards, payments and withdrawals across a range of funding schemes.
- Ensuring funding is awarded accurately and in line with the relevant eligibility criteria and procedures.
- Processing payments and associated accounting entries accurately and efficiently.
- Maintaining funding records, including applications, queries, payments and adjustments.
- Preparing award notifications, payment schedules and communications.
- Providing friendly, professional and knowledgeable support to members with funding-related enquiries.
- Supporting management reporting, month-end and year-end activities.
- Working closely with colleagues across Finance and wider professional services to deliver an excellent experience.
- Contributing to improvements in finance processes, procedures and systems.
It's a great opportunity for someone who enjoys combining finance, administration and customer service and is looking for a flexible part-time position.
What You Need to Succeed To thrive in this role, you'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within finance administration, or a similar financial support role.
- Excellent attention to detail and confidence working with financial information and maintaining accurate records.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills, with a professional and approachable manner.
- Confidence in working independently while also contributing as part of a wider team.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and identifying potential issues.
What You'll Get in Return
- Flexible part-time hours - 20 hours per week. ( 29,588 full-time equivalent).
- The chance to make a genuine difference to the member experience through the delivery of essential financial support.
- Valuable experience across funding, finance administration and customer service.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.
- Convenient location in the Bath area.
- Dedicated support from your Hays consultant throughout your assignment.
What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Project Coordinator - Full time
description:
About the Role

As a Project Coordinator, you'll manage multiple moving parts, keeping stakeholders informed, processes on track, and standards high.

Key Responsibilities
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and accurate documentation.
- Maintain up-to-date systems and reports for project tracking and performance monitoring.
- Deliver an excellent candidate and stakeholder experience - balancing efficiency with empathy.
- Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration across the team.

About You
- Exceptionally organised with strong administrative and coordination skills.
- Confident communicator who enjoys supporting people through structured processes.
- Previous experience in project coordination, HR support, onboarding, or education administration is ideal.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, team-focused approach with strong attention to detail.

What's on Offer
- Flexible working hours and supportive, people-centred culture.
- Monthly well-being sessions and regular social events.
- Stylish, modern office in central Bath with great local amenities.

title: Property Coordinator
description:
Job Description

Allen & Harris, part of Connells Group is looking for a motivated Property Coordinator to complement our fantastic team in Bath. As our Property Coordinator you will provide property management and tenancy administration support services to branches, landlords and tenants.

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm, plus one Saturday per month, 9am-2pm, with a day off in lieu.

What's in it for you as our Property Coordinator?
- Support in training towards ARLA - NFOPP qualifications
- Industry leading training and development
- Demonstrable career ladder
- Clear opportunities to progress within Connells Group
- Collaborative, rewarding and fun environment
- Team incentives

Key responsibilities of a Property Coordinator:
- Arrange all required safety inspections and certification in line with current legislation
- Ensure routine and additional property visits and checks are carried out in the required time frame
- Liaise with contractors/outsourcing resources to ensure repair/maintenance works are carried out to a satisfactory standard and timescale and in line with guarantees/warranties
- Where possible and financially viable for the client, to claim for repair/maintenance work under insurance
- Establish whether liability for work is landlords or tenants
- Ensure that the relevant payments are instructed promptly and properly regarding contractors, deposits and landlord bills

Skills and experience required to be a successful Property Coordinator:
- Outstanding Customer Service skills
- Solid administration skills
- Resilient, positive, numerate and detail oriented
- Organised and able to prioritise workload in a faced paced environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- IT literate (MS Office, internet, email systems)

Connells Group UK is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of , race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.
